paper.title: Measuring the Welfare Effects of Shame and Pride

findings.description: The shipped computational pipeline was not executed. Stata is absent, and the required full direct translation of the build and analysis scripts into R was not completed in this run.
findings.evidence: The package README specifies Stata (last run with version 15). The source package includes master_file.do, three build scripts, and eight analysis scripts. Sys.which('stata') and Sys.which('stata-se') returned empty strings. The environment check log confirms no analysis execution.
findings.suggested_fix: Complete a command-by-command R translation of the full pipeline and rerun it against the shipped raw data, then check each printed result at its displayed precision.

limitations: No article result values were recomputed or checked. The claims inventory is empty because no result-level audit was completed; this is not evidence that the paper contains no numerical claims.
The procedure requested direct translation of the entire Stata pipeline. This deliverable does not include that translation, so it does not satisfy the requested reproduction study.
Original code and data remain at the supplied local package path and were not copied or uploaded.
